Hi Priya —

Appreciate the clear asks. Draft MAP attached (MAP_v1.xlsx) — high level notes here so your procurement and legal teams can triage quickly:

1) Non-negotiable sequencing (hard gates)
   - DPA final signoff required before live data ingestion or production keys issued.
   - Security evidence (SOC2 extract + architecture diagram) delivered to Vantem security team and validated by your SRE/security owner before order form activation.

2) Parallelizable activities (soft lanes that can proceed while legal negotiates)
   - Technical onboarding: integration planning, test dataset provisioning, and performance evals can start under a temporary sandbox key.
   - SSO configuration and IP allowlist prep work (RB: provisioned test ranges) — no production access until DPA accepted.

3) Conditional acceptance path
   - If legal needs more time on narrow DPA clauses, we can provide a limited-scope addendum for data residency/retention for Jan 10 go-live, with final DPA to follow within 30 days of order form signature. This requires sign-off from Redwood legal; see redline approach in orderform-redlines-v1.docx.

4) Proposed timeline to meet your Jan 10 production target (assumes procurement signs during week of Dec 6):
   - Nov 24: Redwood sends SOC2 extract and updated redlines (attached).
   - Nov 30: Vantem security confirmation on evidence + list of blockers.
   - Dec 6–10: Procurement/legal final negotiation window.
   - Dec 13: Target order form signature (buffer before holidays).
   - Dec 14–Jan 9: Technical onboarding, testing, restricted staging.
   - Jan 10: Production enablement (conditional, pending DPA finalization if needed).

Questions for you: who on your side will be the security/evidence owner (name & email) and the procurement approver for sign-off? If Dec 13 is too soon for procurement, tell us the latest available signature date and we will push the plan out accordingly.

I can join a joint session next Tue or Wed — Karthik and Rishi are looped for legal/pricing context.
